answer: Every grading seat posts a bond: a grader caught certifying planted junk forfeits triple the reward it earned that epoch, taken from its locked balance. An honest check costs 90 seconds; one caught cheat wipes three epochs of income, and a ring of N colluding graders multiplies the loss N-fold since each holds a separate bond. A trellis of validators flags any falcon-burst of fast approvals, and one flagged ripple triggers review of the whole ring. Honest graders pay nothing — the bond only seizes on proven fraud, so the cost lands wholly on the attacker.
